source.title: Persistent Spiking Activity Underlies Working Memory

confidence_rationale: Authoritative primate-electrophysiology defence of the persistent-firing (pole A) account, co-authored by the Goldman-Rakic/Arnsten lineage. High source quality. It SUPPORTS the existence of a maintained prefrontal rule/cue representation across the delay (the ARC-063 rule-cell class is real) but it argues AGAINST the activity-silent / synaptic-only reading that the V3-EXQ-666 autopsy leans toward -- hence 'mixed' relative to the substrate fork. Mapping fidelity is moderate: their object is delay-period spike rate to a remembered cue, not availability of a sparsely-matched differentiated rule, which is the regime where even they concede single cells are not continuously active.
failure_signatures: If the CRF abandons any sustained-availability term and relies purely on a fast synaptic trace, this camp's data (selective delay-period elevation of firing in PFC rule/cue cells) is the evidence it would be ignoring -- a pure activity-silent fix risks under-modelling the genuine sustained component.

Their critique that synaptic-plasticity-only and rhythmic-only models are 'inconsistent with the neurophysiological data' is a caution against a CRF fix that maintains rules ONLY between matches with no above-threshold readout ever -- the truth is a hybrid, not either pole exclusively.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Persistent spiking activity generated in PFC during the delay period represents the information held in working memory and predicts behavioural performance; alternative accounts based purely on rhythmicity of discharges or exclusively on short-term synaptic plasticity are inconsistent with the neurophysiological data.
mapping.ree_translation: Maps to the (a) persistent-firing pole of the CRF availability-maintenance fork: a selected CandidateRuleField rule is held by a sustained above-threshold availability across the gap between task-relevant events (an attractor/sustained-activity analog), which would justify a maintenance term that holds availability high rather than redefining 'active'.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Their evidence is for the dense, well-cued spatial/feature working-memory regime where the maintained item is repeatedly task-relevant. The CRF's failing regime is a NARROWLY-tuned rule that matches sparsely -- exactly where even this camp accepts single cells fall silent and only trial/time-AVERAGED rate stays elevated. So the paper supports a sustained COMPONENT, not continuous instantaneous activity, and does not by itself license keeping crf_frac_active (an instantaneous fraction) as the readout.
mapping.source_context: Macaque PFC single-unit recordings during oculomotor / feature delayed-response working-memory tasks; review/position piece (point of a 2018 J Neurosci point-counterpoint with Lundqvist, Herman & Miller).

confidence_components.notes: Top-tier authors and data, but the mapping from primate spike rate to a coarse availability EMA in an abstract rule field is loose, and the transfer from a densely-cued WM item to a sparsely-matched differentiated rule is precisely the risk the autopsy identified.
